request: make me a tiny team status page: a Status box and a Save button, and a line under them that says Current status with whatever i saved. it should still be there after a reload
design_rationale: A status page is one quick capture: a narrow column with the Status box and Save button on top and a single Current status line below, neutral base with the amber accent on the one action, Inter for plain readable text.

verify.steps: Open the page, see No status yet, type Shipping today in the Status box and press Save, see Current status: Shipping today, reload and see it still there.

why.services/status.jac: StatusNote node holding one str under root; read_status and save_status, both def:pub, with save_status returning the stored text.
why.components/StatusBoard.jac: The whole screen: heading, Status box and Save button, the Current status line, loading and empty states.
why.main.jac: Registers the status endpoints, loads global.css and renders the status board.

write_reasoning.services/status.jac: Backend first: one StatusNote node under root is found or created by a helper, and every endpoint is a def:pub. save_status ignores an empty text and returns the stored text so the client never reads again.
write_reasoning.components/StatusBoard.jac: The component owns all state and loads the text in async can with entry. store_status is async, awaits save_status and shows what it returns, and the submit handler ignores an empty box and clears it.
write_reasoning.main.jac: Last, main.jac: it imports services.status with no leading dot so both endpoints are registered, and returns the status board; one screen needs no router.

plan_call_reasoning: Plan the build: one screen with one saved value, so a single component and a small server.
plan_reasoning: One screen: a Status box, a Save button and a Current status line. The text lives on one node under root, read and saved through def:pub functions, with the save returning the stored text. main.jac last.
plan_summary: Build plan written to .jaccoder/build_plan.json: a single-screen capture tool, 3 files leaf-first, the status text on the server with def:pub endpoints, nova/neutral/amber/inter.
journal:
# Agent journal

## Issues
- A def:pub read is cached on the client on jac 0.34.28, so after saving the line shows the text save_status returns instead of reading again.

## Learnings
- The form's onSubmit handler calls preventDefault, ignores an empty box, starts the async save and clears the box.
- The server keeps the old text when it is sent an empty one.

## Last Action
Built Team status: a Status box with a Save button and a Current status line that loads on open. Saving Shipping today shows it in the line and it survives a reload.
final:
Team status is running: type in the Status box, press Save and the Current status line shows it, and it is still there after a reload. I saved Shipping today and it stayed.

**Next steps**
- Keep a short history of past statuses
- Show who saved the status and when
- Add a Clear button
